name: tg-transfer-pricing
description: Togo transfer pricing reference for the 2026 tax year, covering associated domestic and foreign enterprises, the arm’s length principle, annual simplified declarations, full audit documentation and country by country reporting. Use it for prix de transfert, entreprises liées, documentation complète, déclaration simplifiée, CbCR and indirect profit transfers. It distinguishes the substantive pricing rule from separate turnover and asset thresholds, includes indirect ownership and common control conditions, and explains why a business below the full documentation threshold still needs transaction evidence. The Guide records preparation and response deadlines and the statutory fine floors, while preserving open implementation and exchange jurisdiction questions rather than assuming a foreign group filing settles the Togolese obligation.
